answer: Epoch-Linked Consistency Scoring. Each identity's actions are hashed into an epoch digest, and the next epoch's weight derives from drift against its own prior trail. A sparrow-sized anomaly in one epoch, compounded across a long horizon, drags cumulative weight toward the tide line where rewards thin out. To reach the network's zenith, an attacker must sustain coherent behavior across many epochs, multiplying per-identity maintenance cost by the full run length rather than a single signup.
